description: (K)₂NaYBr₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaYBr₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a distorted cuboctahedral geometry to  atoms. In the NaYBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form YBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Br bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Y atom.
